# Your Privacy Choices

Last updated: October 8, 2026

Our public website uses Google Analytics, Google Ads and the LinkedIn Insight Tag to measure our ads and to show our ads to people who have visited us. They never run inside the JobProfitAI app and never see your QuickBooks data. Some state laws treat this kind of advertising as a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information. You can opt out here. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy#cookies) explains these tools in full.

## Opt out in this browser

*The switch on this page shows one of three messages, depending on the browser:*

- **Browser not sending Global Privacy Control, visitor has not opted out:** “Analytics and advertising in this browser: on. Our website pages can load Google Analytics, Google Ads and the LinkedIn Insight Tag in this browser. Turning them off also opts you out of the sale or sharing of your personal information and of targeted advertising through our website.” Button: “Turn off analytics and advertising.”
- **After the visitor turns them off:** “Analytics and advertising in this browser: off. You’ve turned off our analytics and advertising tags in this browser. They won’t load on our website while this choice is saved.” Button: “Turn them back on.”
- **Browser sending Global Privacy Control (no button):** “Global Privacy Control signal received and honored. Your browser is sending a Global Privacy Control signal. We treat it as a request to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information and of targeted advertising, so our analytics and advertising tags don’t load in this browser. You don’t need to do anything else here.”

Your choice is saved in a cookie in this browser. If you clear your cookies, or use another browser or device, make the choice there too. A browser or extension that sends [Global Privacy Control](https://globalprivacycontrol.org) does this for you on every site that honors it, including ours.

Opting out stops our tags from collecting anything new in this browser, and we won’t send Google or LinkedIn your sign-up or subscription from our servers if you sign up while opted out. It doesn’t delete what Google and LinkedIn already hold. You can manage that with them:

- [Google’s ad settings](https://adssettings.google.com) and the [Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout);
- LinkedIn’s advertising settings in your LinkedIn account, or its [guest controls](https://www.linkedin.com/psettings/guest-controls) if you don’t have an account; and
- the industry opt-out pages of the [Network Advertising Initiative](https://optout.networkadvertising.org) and the [Digital Advertising Alliance](https://optout.aboutads.info).

## Other requests

To opt out by email instead, or to ask us to access, correct or delete your information, or to stop contacting you, email [support@jobprofitai.com](mailto:support@jobprofitai.com). We don’t sell personal information for money, and we never use your QuickBooks data, jobs, customers or figures for advertising. The [Your choices and rights](/privacy#rights) section of our Privacy Policy explains each request and how we handle it.
